title: H Is for Happiness
description: An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again.

title: A Dog and Pony Show
description: Dede, a famous performing circus dog, gets left behind when her show leaves town. When she is adopted by a lonely boy on a farm, the vain dog has to learn to get along with the other animals.

title: Sea Level
description: When poachers steal dozens of egg sacks from his reef, bamboo shark Pup makes it his personal mission to save his unhatched brothers and sisters. His rescue mission takes him above water into the world of man.

title: Sea Level 2: Magic Arch
description: A young dolphin with an active imagination discovers a magic arch that makes wishes come true. However, when its enemies use the arch to become big and strong, it must find a way to stop them.

title: Sea Level 3: Dolphin Boy
description: A little boy survives a plane crash and is rescued by a young wild dolphin. They grow up together, entertaining marine life with their funny tricks. One day, the peace of their joyful world is destroyed by an evil octopus.

title: Adam Sandler's Eight Crazy Nights
description: Davey Stone, a 33-year-old party animal, finds himself in trouble with the law after his wild ways go too far. In keeping with the holiday spirit, the judge gives Davey one last chance at redemption, spend the holiday performing community service as the assistant referee for the youth basketball league or go to jail. Davey thinks he's gotten off easy until he meets Whitey Duvall, the eccentric, elf-like head referee.

title: My Sweet Monster
description: Princess Barbara is secretly in love with Prince Edward. When the sneaky post clerk Weasel demands the king to marry him to Barbara, she flees. Sweet monster Bogey does everything in his might to help Barbara save the kingdom.

title: Measure of a Man
description: A teen develops a bond with a Wall Street executive while learning to stand up to bullies during one life-changing summer.

title: The Great Gilly Hopkins
description: Young and feisty Gilly Hopkins (Sophie Nélisse) devises a scheme to escape from her new foster home and reunite with her birth mother.

title: Let Us In
description: A 12-year-old girl is determined to uncover who or what is behind the rash of disappearances occurring in her small town.

title: All Is Lost
description: During a solo voyage in the Indian Ocean, a veteran mariner (Robert Redford) awakes to find his vessel taking on water after a collision with a stray shipping container. With his radio and navigation equipment disabled, he sails unknowingly into a violent storm and barely escapes with his life. With any luck, the ocean currents may carry him into a shipping lane -- but, with supplies dwindling and the sharks circling, the sailor is forced to face his own mortality.

title: A Mouse Tale
description: At the request of the king, Sebastian (Drake Bell) and Samantha (Miranda Cosgrove) must find a legendary crystal with the power to defeat an army of rats.

title: A Richer Christmas
description: When a wealthy family loses everything before the holidays, their world falls apart - but in the chaos, they discover the true meaning of Christmas.

title: The Young and Prodigious T.S. Spivet
description: T.S. is invited to the Smithsonian to receive an award for inventing a perpetual motion machine. Without telling any of his family, he boards a freight train heading to Washington, D.C., to attend the ceremony.
